mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ast_tree( ast01_class_tree_id , ast01_class_tree_nm , ast01_parent_tree_id , ast01_seq , ast01_class_tree_cd , ast01_type_cd , ast01_isin , depth , path , cycle ) AS ( SELECT ast01_class_tree_id , ast01_class_tree_nm , ast01_parent_tree_id , ast01_seq , ast01_class_tree_cd , ast01_type_cd , ast01_isin , 1 , ARRAY[CAST(a.ast01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.ast01_seq AS varchar),10,'0')||a.ast01_class_tree_cd||LPAD(CAST(a.ast01_class_tree_id AS varchar),15,'0')] , false FROM ast01_class_tree a WHERE 1=1 AND ast01_parent_tree_id = 0 AND ast01_use_yn = 'true' AND ast01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} AND ast01_asset_type LIKE #{c.assetType} AND ast01_company_id = #{c.companyId} UNION ALL SELECT a.ast01_class_tree_id , a.ast01_class_tree_nm , a.ast01_parent_tree_id , a.ast01_seq , a.ast01_class_tree_cd , a.ast01_type_cd , a.ast01_isin , b.depth + 1 , array_append(b.path, CAST(a.ast01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.ast01_seq AS varchar),10,'0')||a.ast01_class_tree_cd||LPAD(CAST(a.ast01_class_tree_id AS varchar),15,'0')) , a.ast01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM ast01_class_tree a INNER JOIN ast_tree b ON a.ast01_parent_tree_id = b.ast01_class_tree_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.ast01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.ast01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} AND a.ast01_asset_type LIKE #{c.assetType} AND a.ast01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND not cycle ) SELECT a.ast01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , a.ast01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id , a.ast01_class_tree_nm ||CASE WHEN a.ast01_type_cd != 'IT' THEN '' ELSE (CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.ast01_isin,'X') != 'X' THEN ' ('||a.ast01_isin||')' ELSE '' END) END AS class_tree_name , a.ast01_type_cd AS type_code , a.depth AS depth FROM ast_tree a WHERE 1=1 AND ( ( a.ast01_type_cd = 'IT' AND ( ( #{c.userId} IN ( SELECT ast10_person_id FROM ast10_manager WHERE ast10_manager_type = '1' AND ast10_link_id = a.ast01_class_tree_id ) ) OR ( #{c.orgId} IN ( SELECT ast10_org_id FROM ast10_manager WHERE ast10_manager_type = '2' AND ast10_link_id = a.ast01_class_tree_id ) ) ) ) OR ( a.ast01_type_cd != 'IT' ) ) ORDER BY path

SELECT a.ast01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , a.ast01_isin AS isin , a.ast01_class_tree_full_nm AS class_tree_full_name FROM ( SELECT distinct ast01_class_tree.ast01_class_tree_id , ast01_class_tree.ast01_isin , f_ast_class_tree_nm_allpath2(ast01_class_tree_id) as ast01_class_tree_full_nm FROM ast01_class_tree , fnd10_book WHERE ast01_class_tree_id = fnd10_ast_class_tree_id AND ast01_type_cd = 'IT' AND ast01_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast01_asset_type = #{assetType} AND fnd10_std_date = #{stdDate} ) a WHERE upper(ast01_isin||ast01_class_tree_full_nm) like '%'||upper(#{searchText})||'%' ORDER BY ast01_class_tree_full_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc
